external_binding_steps: Create/connect one Render Blueprint instance from render.yaml.
Provide CEW_ACCESS_PASSWORD in Render environment configuration.
Provide CEW_AUDIT_NEON_DATABASE_URL in Render environment configuration.
Deploy the exact immutable HVA candidate SHA using Render Deploy a specific commit.

current_hva_candidate.reason: The existing candidate predates the /readyz and Render managed-runtime hardening introduced by this policy. It remains valid historical automated evidence but is not the target Render HVA revision.

next_candidate_rule: The next B1.8 candidate must include the Render managed-runtime hardening, pass the full automated gate set on one immutable SHA, then be deployed to Render by exact SHA before HVA.
